product11.finding: The frozen v1 projection required and emitted raw source locations while the locked Product #11 selector boundary forbade them. Gate C never started.

product12.finding: The repaired v2 selector boundary operated with zero raw-location or semantic leakage. Shriram yielded seven authorized blind metadata destinations and seven valid v2 projections, but those projections contained zero exact UIN identities; the other three candidate insurer paths produced no v2 product metadata projections. No product was selected.

runtime_boundary_findings.v2_projection_boundary_reason: Product #12 demonstrated that raw source locations can remain machine-side while the selector receives deterministic source_ref identity plus product/UIN metadata only.
runtime_boundary_findings.uin_extractor_reason: UinCandidateExtractor promotes only labelled UIN occurrences present in supplied source text and deliberately does not establish verified product ownership.
runtime_boundary_findings.gate_c_consumption_gap: Gate C consumed first-hop authorized metadata pages and projected ProductSignalExtractor output, but did not provide a governed generic stage that recursively acquires second-hop metadata artifacts or regulator product-index evidence before exact-UIN/currentness selection.
runtime_boundary_findings.downstream_currentness_gate_reason: CurrentProductRepeatabilityEvidenceEligibility correctly evaluates an already-bound exact document version/currentness overlay; it cannot compensate for missing preselection product identity/currentness evidence.

diagnosis.site_specific_evidence_scarcity_detail: Three of four Product #12 insurer origins did not yield accepted metadata paths in the live run, so site transport/discovery limitations remain real. However, the Shriram path proves that even when authorized metadata destinations are available, the current Gate C path can terminate before reaching exact identity/currentness evidence carried by deeper metadata artifacts.

required_prospective_capability.position_in_pipeline: after authorized blind metadata-path discovery and before neutral product selection
required_prospective_capability.purpose: Machine-side traversal and normalization of product-identity/currentness evidence without exposing raw locations or semantic-bearing target content to the selector.
minimum_responsibilities: consume only authorized blind metadata destinations resolved machine-side
support bounded traversal from metadata landing pages to metadata artifacts such as PDF/download/table resources when the artifact class is authorized
preserve source provenance and immutable content hashes for every acquired metadata artifact
extract exact product names, UINs, version/currentness signals and source identity without target-clause semantic inspection
support insurer-controlled and regulator-controlled metadata evidence when available
deduplicate by exact source identity while preserving distinct-source corroboration
emit only blind_preselection_product_metadata_v2-compatible selector projections or a separately frozen successor contract that remains raw-location-free
fail closed when artifact type, product ownership, UIN binding, version or currentness is ambiguous
enforce bounded depth and deterministic traversal order
keep policy wording/prospectus/CIS target-clause inspection unauthorized before selection and positive currentness eligibility

non_goals: Do not weaken the v2 raw-location firewall.
Do not broaden semantic extraction before selection.
Do not reinterpret or retry Products #11 or #12.
Do not preregister Product #13 until the prospective repair is implemented, tested and independently frozen.
